name: app-doses
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile driven by another app over Bluetooth, as a pump moved from Tandem's app or another Loop or Trio: app boluses of 3.0 U 280 minutes ago, 1.5 U 150 and 0.6 U 40, and app temp rates, each with its SetTempRateResponse record: 120% for 30 minutes from 240 minutes ago, 0% for 30 minutes from 180, 140% set for 60 minutes 100 minutes ago and stopped after 30, and 50% for 60 minutes from 25 minutes ago, still running with 35 minutes left. With Control-IQ off the pump shows about 1.5 U IOB.
